purpose: Replace legacy direct-source-only static document links with publicly verified R2 archives while preserving official source links and existing site descriptions.

decisions.title: 2003 General Obligation Bond Operating and Maintenance Cost Impacts
decisions.description: Projects the operating and maintenance costs of the 2003 Albuquerque general-obligation bond projects across cultural services, technology, parks, public safety, planning, and transit through fiscal year 2008.

decisions.title: 2013 General Obligation Bond Program Summary
decisions.description: Summarizes the 2013 Albuquerque general-obligation bond program by department and purpose, providing a concise historical overview of planned capital investment.

decisions.title: APD Forensics Solar Carport Design Overview
decisions.description: Documents a 579.4-kilowatt solar-carport design for the Albuquerque Police Department Forensics site, identifying modules, inverters, arrays, wiring, and the 5350 Second Street Northwest location.

decisions.title: City of Albuquerque Selection Advisory Committee Rules and Regulations
decisions.description: Sets City procedures for selecting architectural, engineering, landscape-architecture, design-build, and related professional-service firms, including solicitation, evaluation, public-meeting, scoring, interview, award, and appeal requirements.

decisions.title: Department of Municipal Development Capital Facilities and Parking Scope
decisions.description: Details $1.3 million in 2013 municipal-development capital scopes for facilities, energy and security upgrades, parking rehabilitation, Plaza del Sol improvements, roofs, plumbing, and vehicles.

decisions.title: Family and Community Services 2009 General Obligation Bond Scope
decisions.description: Details $14.5 million in 2009 Family and Community Services bond scopes for community-center renovation, reconstruction, security, vehicles, and food-storage facilities.

decisions.title: Development Process Executive Committee Minutes, September 24, 2014
decisions.description: Records committee approval of Development Process Manual changes to fire-flow requirements, on-street parking, and grading and erosion-control standards, while documenting the update-procedure discussion.

decisions.title: Legalization of Cannabis in New Mexico: Planning Commissioner Workshop
decisions.description: Explains the 2021 Cannabis Regulation Act for local planners, covering licenses, local time-place-manner authority, limits on municipal restrictions, taxation, employment, and implementation deadlines.

decisions.title: Manzano Mesa Park Prescription Trail Guide
decisions.description: Maps a 0.6-mile accessible concrete walking route at Manzano Mesa Park, with route directions, accessibility grade, nearby transit, parking, facilities, and neighborhood connections.

decisions.title: Fleet Storage Yard Candelaria Storm Water Pollution Prevention Plan
decisions.description: Sets City controls for stormwater from the Candelaria fleet storage yard, documenting industrial activities, pollutants, drainage to the Rio Grande, impaired-water monitoring, inspections, spill response, and corrective actions.

decisions.title: Girard Boulevard Existing Conditions Assessment
decisions.description: Maps and illustrates 2012 corridor conditions on Girard Boulevard between Indian School Road and Constitution Avenue, including roadway width, medians, parking demand, sidewalks, pedestrian safety, and accessibility constraints.
